name: League of Legends: 2026 Season One - For Demacia
summary: League of Legends "For Demacia" is the first thematic season of 2026, launching January 8, 2026, with a focus on the militaristic kingdom of Demacia. The season features a Demacia-themed Summoner’s Rift map, the "Demacia Rising" in-client narrative meta-game, and a visual update for Shyvana in Act II
